name: Length Converter
summary: Convert length between metric and imperial units — meters, feet, miles, and more — in your browser.
description: Enter a length and see millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards, and miles update instantly. Conversion math runs locally with no upload.

faqs.question: Which length units are supported?
faqs.answer: mm, cm, m, km, inches, feet, yards, and miles.

faqs.question: Is data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. All conversion happens in your browser.

faqs.question: How accurate is it?
faqs.answer: Factors use standard SI definitions (e.g. 1 in = 0.0254 m exactly).
